summary: The CostCentre class manages cost centre information related to placements, including properties for agencies, departments, services, and financial details.
purpose: To provide detailed records of cost centres associated with various entities such as placements and financial operations.

entities.name: CostCentreRecord
entities.description: Represents a record in the cost centre with details about agencies, services, and financials.

fields.name: PlacingAgency
fields.description: The agency responsible for placing the service or record.

fields.name: Department
fields.description: Department associated with the cost centre.
